text: In accordance with the Relationship Framework approved by City Council for the Toronto Licensing Tribunal, the Chair's 2016 and 2017 Annual Reports are being communicated to the Licensing and Standards Committee for information. The Toronto Licensing Tribunal is an independent quasi-judicial body consisting of seven citizens chosen by City Council for a four-year term. The Toronto Licensing Tribunal makes decisions about business licensing matters that are brought forward by Municipal Licensing and Standards, in accordance with Chapter 545, Business Licensing, and Chapter 546, Licensing of Vehicles-for-Hire. Typically, the Annual Report would be communicated yearly. The Chair of the Tribunal changed in 2017, resulting in a delay in the delivery of the 2016 report.
